title: "Penguin Explorer"

## Predict Penguin Body Mass

This project demonstrates a complete MLOps pipeline for predicting penguin body mass using the [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/) dataset.

### Features

- **Machine Learning Model**: Linear regression trained on bill length, species, and sex
- **REST API**: Model served via [Vetiver](https://vetiver.rstudio.com/) and FastAPI
- **Dual Frontend**: Interactive Shiny applications in both Python and R
- **Containerized**: Full Docker Compose setup for easy deployment

### Architecture

```
┌─────────────────┐     ┌─────────────────┐
│  Shiny Python   │────▶│                 │
│   (port 8000)   │     │   Vetiver API   │
└─────────────────┘     │   (port 8080)   │
                        │                 │
┌─────────────────┐     │   ┌─────────┐   │
│    Shiny R      │────▶│   │  Model  │   │
│   (port 3838)   │     │   └─────────┘   │
└─────────────────┘     └─────────────────┘
```

### Quick Start

```bash
docker compose up --build
```

Then open:

- **Python App**: [http://localhost:8000](http://localhost:8000)
- **R App**: [http://localhost:3838](http://localhost:3838)
- **API Docs**: [http://localhost:8080/docs](http://localhost:8080/docs)

### Model Performance

The linear regression model uses the following features:

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `bill_length_mm` | Bill length in millimeters |
| `species` | Adelie, Chinstrap, or Gentoo |
| `sex` | Male or Female |

See the [Model](/notebooks/model-vetiver.qmd) page for training details and performance metrics.
